extractors.title: Extractors
extractors.intro: Separate programs that turn replays and levels from your own game installs into what 3DHeat reads. Installed in their own folder, started as programs of their own.
extractors.autoUpdateTitle: Off: every update is shown with its release notes first and installed only when you choose Update now. On: looking for updates installs them (not a version you skipped).
extractors.ask.title: Update extractors
extractors.maps.new: {n, plural, one {# new map available} other {# new maps available}}
extractors.get.intro: Get the extractors: each one is a separate program you download from its releases page and run on your own machine. It reads the game from your own install and writes levels and tables that 3DHeat opens.
extractors.get.note: In the 3DHeat app, this panel installs, updates and starts them for you.
extractors.start.title: Get your maps into 3DHeat
extractors.start.step1: Install the extractor for your game below.
extractors.start.step2: It checks your game install and says if anything is missing.
extractors.start.step3: Extract the new maps: they appear in the level list and in the Library.
extractors.runTitle: Start the extractor as a program of its own
extractors.checkTitle: Check again what it needs from your game install
extractors.fix.manager: 3DHeat's extractor service did not answer. Try again; if it keeps failing, restart 3DHeat.
extractors.fix.install: The install did not finish. Check the internet connection, then try again.
extractors.fix.check: It could not check what it needs. Check again; if that keeps failing, remove it and install it again.
extractors.fix.checks: Fix what is marked ✗ (the extractor's page on GitHub says how), then check again.
extractors.fix.status: It could not read your game install. Make sure the game is installed and not running, then look again.
extractors.fix.mapsFailed: Close the game if it runs, then extract the failed maps again.
extractors.maps.extractNew: {n, plural, one {Extract # new map} other {Extract # new maps}}
